fire: In 1612 the young duke of Mantua inherited the palace and its debts.
Sound is absorbed by a steel baffle fitted inside the exhaust pipe.
The printers are connected in a daisy chain from the first port.
Every Nonterminal symbol on the right-hand side is expanded in turn.
A steam dredge was moored at the mouth of the canal all summer.
The emperor made his cousin a duke and gave him lands in the north.
The tank has an internal baffle to stop the fuel from sloshing.
The grammar defines one Nonterminal for expressions and one for statements.
